system.description:
A song sung of all the victories of the Elves—this one included. The Hymn forces the enemy to choose Stand and Drool as a hesitation option from a failed Steel test while this song is being sung. The Hymn of Victory is a fine way to round up and finish off the straggling remnants of the enemy forces.

Obstacle: See description. Enemy squad, Ob 1. Enemy company, Ob 2. Battalion, Ob 3. Army, Ob 5.

Actions: 60

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 147
